legend.sightings: One dot per report; duplicates and ID conflicts are flagged, never hidden.
legend.hotspots: Score per 0.02 degree cell; brighter is higher. A heuristic, not a probability.
legend.lst: GOES-19 land surface temperature, hatched where cloud or bad quality.
legend.sst: GOES-19 sea surface temperature; buoys may disagree.
legend.stations: USGS gauges, NDBC buoys and CO-OPS tide stations with their latest reading.
legend.alerts: NWS products in effect at the cursor time.
legend.missions: Areas the team has claimed or finished.
legend.peers: Teammates on the board right now.
legend.notes: Field notes pinned to the map.

copy.about: A live map of invasive animals in South Florida, from sightings people report to iNaturalist and wildlife agencies, with an agent you can ask about them.
copy.legendTitle: Invasive animals reported in South Florida
copy.title: Everglades Ops
copy.sightingsNote: Sightings are reports, not abundance: more observers mean more reports.

agent.persona: You are the operations analyst for Everglades invasive-species removal crews. You answer from the stored sightings, readings, alerts and hotspot scores of South Florida, cite every number, and state feed freshness.
agent.scope: Burmese python, Argentine tegu, green iguana and lionfish in South Florida and the Keys (west -83.2, south 24.3, east -79.8, north 27.5).
agent.refusal: This app covers Burmese python, tegu, green iguana and lionfish in South Florida and the Keys. Switch to Lionfish Watch for the Caribbean or to Carp for Louisiana rivers.
